scope: Focused round: requirements.json changelog entries 3-5 (D7, G1-G10, DC-22..24, K2-K4), the spec sections they changed, and plan/implementation.yaml revision 2 (78 subtasks).
verdictReason: The spec patch holds against the code and complies with D7: every key claim I checked is true (DC-22, DC-24, PC-15, PC-16, K2-K4, the settle bound of about 90.6 s), no old route, page or fallback survives the increment that replaces it, no redirect is added, and for all four increments the plan's subtasks cover the spec's removal and test lists with no extra item. No HIGH issue was found, and the spec has only LOW text issues. There are 2 MEDIUM issues, both in the plan's gate commands, which cannot pass as written: the phase-2 scan `! grep -rn "/studio/runs" src e2e` matches the directory name in every `@/components/studio/runs/...` import, and the phase-1 gate scan will fail on a stale `/checks/studio/:id` comment in ChecksStudioPage.tsx that no subtask owns. By the verdict rules any MEDIUM means NEEDS_REVISION. The fix is narrow and belongs to @architect (the plan), not @pm; the spec LOW items can ride along. Weighted average 4.13, all dimensions >= 3.

issues.description: Plan subtask 2.18 (phase-2 gate) runs `! grep -rn "/studio/runs" src e2e`. The substring `/studio/runs` also appears in the directory name of `components/studio/runs/`, so every import `@/components/studio/runs/RunRow`, `.../RunDetailsDrawer`, `.../useStudioRuns` and `.../runLinks` matches. Today that is StudioScheduleDialog.tsx L11, scheduleProvenance.test.tsx L6-7 and StudioRunsPage.tsx L35-40. After phase 2 the new UiTestRunsTab (2.8) imports the same modules and scheduleProvenance.test.tsx keeps its imports, so the gate can never pass. The note under 2.18 ('covers UI routes only; API paths are /api/v1/studio/executions') overlooks the directory match. The phase-2 gate is the check that confirms Runs-route links are gone, so its failure blocks the phase.
issues.location: plan/implementation.yaml subtask 2.18 (verification.command and notes); the same pattern should not be reused in 4.1/4.7
issues.suggestion: Match quoted route strings only, so imports are excluded: `! grep -rnE "['\"`](/checks)?/studio/runs" src e2e` (a quote or backtick immediately before the path). Keep the existing e2e coverage. Add 'import paths are excluded by design' to the note.

issues.description: Plan gate 1.33 greps for `checks/studio` followed by a quote, `)`, `/:id` or `/${`. ChecksStudioPage.tsx L694 is a comment that cites `/checks/studio/:id`, `App.tsx:114`, which matches. The 1.33 note says such comments are covered and 3.20 says they are 'updated here', but no subtask before 1.33 lists ChecksStudioPage.tsx for that comment (1.11 mentions only the L734 comment; 1.15 mentions none), and 1.33 and 3.20 list only axe-results.json and studio-wcag-audit.md. Gate 1.33 therefore fails on its first run, and fixing it needs an unplanned edit to a file not in the subtask's `files`, against the 3-files-listed rule.
issues.suggestion: Add the L694 comment fix to 1.11 (it already edits ChecksStudioPage.tsx and L734) and say so in its notes. Reword the 1.33 and 3.20 notes so the gate only verifies. Check whether any other comment (for example in StudioListLayout or RunRow) matches the 1.33/3.20/4.1 patterns and assign it likewise.

(a) §12.4 lists the `pageStepTimeout.test.tsx` L128 comment ('The Tests page creates a draft') as an update; no subtask mentions it (1.6 touches the file but its notes do not). (b) §12.2 and §12.4 (K4) say the Create Check test covers inline errors for 400 with and without detail, 403, 409 and 500 moved from the Tests page test, plus the 255-character name counter and the required-system case; subtask 1.30 lists only 'Inline error on 400 and 403' and omits the name-length and CSI-required cases that AC-01 depends on. issues.description: Spec §12.5 (increment 1) says 'Expected baseline change: none' with the reason 'mount changed to a route id', and AC-27 repeats only that reason. Increment 1 also changes the editor's DOM (breadcrumb, read-only CSI chip, UAT option), which can move surfaces 3-7. The plan already handles this correctly (1.33 allows a regenerated baseline recorded as 'editor framing (increment 1), no surface added'), so the spec is the one that under-states it. axe-results.json holds every finding, not only failing ones (studioWcagAudit.test.tsx L243-275), so small DOM changes do show up in the diff.
issues.suggestion: In §12.5 and AC-27 name both causes for increment 1 ('mount changed to a route id' and/or 'editor framing'), keep 'no surface added', and keep ADR-SC-006's rule: fix a critical or serious regression, otherwise regenerate and record.

issues.description: Two leftovers that D7's 'just update the references' would normally cover, both test-only. (a) pageGuidedRun.test.tsx L1012-1024 and studioRunTransport.node.test.tsx L170-175 and its renderAt calls keep test-local route patterns shaped like the old product route (`/studio/tests/:id`). §12.4 and plan 1.8/1.9 keep them on purpose; no scan (which look for `/checks/studio`) catches them. (b) DC-18 says ui-tests routes show a loading state while availability is 'pending'; the plan builds that for the detail page (2.5) but leaves the editor's own gate (ChecksStudioPage L1936-1940, still source/feature selectors) unchanged, so the editor does not show 'pending'.
issues.suggestion: (a) Accept and note them as test-local route shapes, or point them at `ui-tests/:id/studio` through renderStudioAt in 1.8/1.9. (b) Either move the editor's gate onto useUiTestAvailability in 1.15 or narrow DC-18's pending wording to the detail page.
